local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local EMOTE_ID = "rbxassetid://507771019"

local function playEmote()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end

	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = EMOTE_ID

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	track:Play()
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		playEmote()
	end
end)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function getTargetPart()
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = (mouse.Hit.Position - origin)
	if direction.Magnitude > 200 then
		direction = direction.Unit * 200
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
	return result and result.Instance or nil
end

mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
	local part = getTargetPart()
	if part then
		print(part.Name)
	end
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local buyItemEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not buyItemEvent then
	buyItemEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyItemEvent.Name = "BuyItem"
	buyItemEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local ITEMS = {
	Sword = {
		Price = 100,
		Tool = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Sword"),
	},
}

local function giveItem(player, itemName)
	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return false, "Item does not exist."
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return false, "Coins not found."
	end

	if coins.Value < item.Price then
		return false, "Not enough coins."
	end

	if player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(itemName) or player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(itemName) then
		return false, "You already own this item."
	end

	coins.Value -= item.Price

	if item.Tool then
		local tool = item.Tool:Clone()
		tool.Parent = player.Backpack
	end

	return true
end

buyItemEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local success, message = giveItem(player, itemName)
	if not success then
		warn(player.Name .. " failed to buy " .. itemName .. ": " .. tostring(message))
	end
end)

	buyPotionEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyPotionEvent.Name = "BuyPotion"
	buyPotionEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getLeaderstat(player, name)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name)
end

buyPotionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, quantity)
	if typeof(quantity) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	quantity = math.floor(quantity)
	if quantity < 1 or quantity > 100 then
		return
	end

	local coins = getLeaderstat(player, "Coins")
	local potions = getLeaderstat(player, "Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

		coins.Value -= totalCost
		potions.Value += quantity
	end

-- Sanitize names
local function sanitizeName(name)
	name = string.gsub(name, "%s+", " ")
	name = string.gsub(name, "^%s+", "")
	name = string.gsub(name, "%s+$", "")
	if #name > 20 then
		name = string.sub(name, 1, 20)
	end
	if #name == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return name
end

-- Handle rename requests
renamePetEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, newName)
	if typeof(newName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local cleanName = sanitizeName(newName)
	if not cleanName then
		return
	end

	local petName = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if petName and petName:IsA("StringValue") then
		petName.Value = cleanName
	end
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local module = {}

function module.addCoins(userId, amount)
	local key = "Player_" .. userId
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	local current = 0
	if success and type(data) == "table" and type(data.coins) == "number" then
		current = data.coins
	end

	local newTotal = current + amount

	local saveSuccess = pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync(key, { coins = newTotal })
	end)

	if saveSuccess then
		return newTotal
	else
		return nil, "Failed to save data"
	end
end

return module

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	local success, savedValue = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	if success and typeof(savedValue) == "number" then
		coins.Value = savedValue
	end

	local sessionData = coins

	coins.Changed:Connect(function(value)
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync(key, value)
		end)
	end)

	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
		if not player.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				store:SetAsync(key, sessionData.Value)
			end)
		end
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, coins.Value)
		end)
	end
end)
